description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, findings C2/C3/C4 ungated parts (evidence
pinned to commit acfb8992). The evaluator-facing evidence chain is broken:

- tuning_config_hash and tuning_source_file are read from kwargs no call site
  passes (benchbox/base.py:757-761; the adapter call at
  platforms/base/adapter.py:851-881 omits both) -> bundle hash always absent,
  source always "auto" (core/results/schema.py:1234). Corpus: 0/528 bundles
  carry a hash.
- build_tuning_payload/_build_tuning_summary extract keys
  (indexes/statistics/configuration) that UnifiedTuningConfiguration.to_dict()
  never produces (schema.py:1250-1258, 1364-1374) -> clauses always empty and
  the requested config is dropped at export entirely.
- TuningResolution provenance (mode/source enum/config file/searched paths) is
  display-only (cli/tuning_resolver.py); TuningSource.INTERACTIVE_WIZARD is
  never assigned.

Fix (decision-safe under ADR-1, which may later ADD an applied-side hash):
thread TuningResolution provenance into run_config -> result capture; export
the requested config canonically (to_dict) plus a clearly-named
requested-config hash; replace the dead clauses extraction with the real
config structure. Record source as the enum value, template as a repo-relative
ref or content hash - never a raw local path.

work_units.notes:
Re-validated against origin/develop @ aea5881c (acfb8992 evidence had moved):
- benchbox/base.py:757-761 (`_populate_builder`) still reads
  `kwargs.get("tuning_config_hash")`/`kwargs.get("tuning_source_file")`
  with no caller passing them - BUT this method (and
  `_create_result_builder`) is dead code with zero production callers
  (only exercised by tests/unit/test_base_advanced.py). The live path is
  `benchbox/core/benchmark_result_validation.py:26` ->
  `benchbox/core/results/result_factory.py:build_enhanced_benchmark_result`
  (`_apply_optional_builder_data`, ~line 122-126), which had the
  identical bug. result_factory.py was added to scope (see deviation
  note) since it is the actual call site the evidence describes, just
  relocated by an intervening refactor.
- adapter.py's `run_enhanced_benchmark` (~line 851-881, was ~743-747/
  851-881 pre-refactor) omitted tuning_config_hash/tuning_source_file/
  tuning_source exactly as described.
- build_tuning_payload/_build_tuning_summary (schema.py, was ~1250-1258/
  1364-1374, now ~1208-1332/1427-1471) extracted
  indexes/statistics/configuration - keys UnifiedTuningConfiguration.
  to_dict() never produces (its keys: primary_keys, foreign_keys,
  unique_constraints, check_constraints, platform_optimizations,
  table_tunings) - confirmed dead, clauses always empty.
- TuningSource.INTERACTIVE_WIZARD (tuning_resolver.py:46) was indeed
  never assigned; both wizard call sites (run.py's
  `_load_unified_tuning_config` fallback branch, and
  `_interactive_tuning_step`) left the resolution's source at its
  pre-wizard value.
ADDITIONAL finding beyond the pinned evidence (confirmed empirically,
not just by inspection - a real `--tuning tuned` duckdb run produced
`platform.tuning: null`, not merely hash-absent): `tuning_enabled` and
`unified_tuning_configuration` never reached the adapter's `__init__`
AT ALL for the CLI's non-interactive/direct run path (`_run_direct`,
dry-run, load-only) - `db_manager.create_config()` only folds
overrides into `DatabaseConfig.options` (nested), while
`PlatformAdapter.__init__` reads them as top-level kwargs via
`from_config()`. This meant `effective_tuning_config` was always None
and no tuning was ever physically applied for these paths (confirmed
for duckdb and postgresql; only questdb's from_config already forwarded
both keys correctly). This is a genuinely separate, more severe,
pre-existing defect from what this TODO's evidence anticipated - fixing
it was a hard prerequisite for verifying w1-w4 end-to-end (otherwise
`effective_tuning_config` is always None and there is nothing to attach
provenance to). Fixed narrowly: run.py now promotes tuning_enabled/
tuning_source/tuning_source_file onto top-level DatabaseConfig fields
(mirroring the interactive wizard path, which already did this for
tuning_enabled), and adapter.py/duckdb.py read them back correctly.
Deliberately did NOT promote unified_tuning_configuration itself onto
DatabaseConfig: it is a pydantic model, and model_dump() (used
downstream to build platform_config) recursively serializes
dataclass-valued extra fields to plain dicts, which would hand the
adapter a dict instead of a UnifiedTuningConfiguration instance. Fixed
adapter.py to read the config object from the existing, already-
reliable `tuning_config` kwarg channel instead (get_platform_config()
always passes it through as a live object reference).
A companion systemic gap - the SAME tuning_enabled/
unified_tuning_configuration forwarding bug exists in ~48 other
platforms' from_config() methods (confirmed for postgresql.py,
sqlite.py, clickhouse/workload.py, starrocks/workload.py,
datafusion.py, motherduck.py; only questdb.py already does it
correctly) - out of scope for this TODO (would touch dozens of files
well beyond scope_limit); flagged for a dedicated follow-up TODO.
Deviations from scope_limit (all narrow, single-purpose, documented in
the PR body): benchbox/core/results/result_factory.py (live call-site
counterpart of base.py's dead code), benchbox/platforms/duckdb.py
(from_config key-forwarding fix, needed to exercise ANY tuning path
end-to-end).
